text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Eh, everyone here has tomorrow off?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a huge coincidence. Can't 
believe something like this happens.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-chan and Cafe-chan said they have 
the day off too. Since we're all free, can 
we do something together?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oho, in that case! Leave it all to 
Golshi-chan for a bit, yo!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Fwahaha. Welcome, travelers. I am the 
guardian deity of this island.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Um, I don't know if I should say it, 
but... You're Golshi-san, right...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Fwahaha... Now that you have set foot upon 
this island, you must participate in a 
sacred ritual.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And that is none other than————A GAME OF 
TAG!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Right, right, when you think of a scenic 
island, you think tag... ————LIKE HECK YA 
DO?!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Desire-chan! Let's do our best 
and catch everyone!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I shall overcome this trial without 
fail...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I happen to have the perfect gadget for 
tag. I call it, the 'Speed-Up-O-Matic'! A 
drone projecting the image of a chasing 
lion!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
By stimulating fear and survival 
instincts, it enables a breakthrough 
beyond one's speed limits! Now, 
Dantsu-kun, try using this to escape the 
pursuers' reach!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Got it! Alright, I'll give it a 
shot!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: No way in hell is that fine!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... It doesn't seem like we have time to 
be bickering, though...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, 'Speed-Up-O-Matic'..!? To think such 
a device existed...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Buena-san, leave this to me. A saint's 
prayer—'Slow-Down-O-Matic'!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
T-This is... It's better if my legs get 
slower, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Like hell it is! Nobody asked for that! 
Wait, aren't we cornered already?!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Alright, it's done.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
S-Ste-Go-senpai! Isn't escaping on a raft 
against the rules, sir?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Mame-chin, rules are just something 
somebody made up. Toss that junk aside... 
and come with us, to the New World.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: B-But still, sir...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Heh, not caring about it is what makes it 
fun. ...Now then, shall we get going?

text_block_list.name: Sound of Waves
text_block_list.text: (*SPLAAAAAAAAAAASH!!*)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Is everyone alright!? Grab onto my hand!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! Glad you're safe! Are you 
unhurt?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
My deepest thanks for the rescue, sir! 
Wait, doesn't this practically mean I've 
been caught by 'it'...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Found you! Journey-san, Orfe-san...!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: A king never retreats.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
—You. Entertain Us. With that, this 
contest shall be settled.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
What a magnificent trial...! ...Yes, I 
would be honored to accept your challenge!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Shall we roleplay my favorite light novel? 
A king like Orfe-san and a holy maiden 
story... I've always, always wanted to try 
it!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"O Holy Maiden, even should this body turn 
to dust for your sake, I care not..." 
First, please try saying this line to me!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. —"O Holy Maiden, even should this 
body turn to dust for your sake, I care 
not..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that was simply perfection...! Next, 
let us do a dialogue together! I have 
several dozen favorite scenes—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. It feels as though we are already 
trapped inside a birdcage, doesn't it?

One holiday, I happened to spot several 
horse girls eating together.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, we made so many wonderful memories, 
didn't we? So many that we couldn't 
possibly finish talking about them in a 
single day.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming such a special ordeal today was 
truly delightful, but... tomorrow, our 
ordinary school life will resume once 
more.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And I find myself looking forward to that 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right. ...Well then, we'd 
better eat lots and keep our spirits high! 
We've gotta give training and studies our 
all, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
ALRIGHT!! TIME TO RECHARGE!! I'm gonna 
chow down until I burst, babyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Me too! I'll eat a ton so I won't lose to 
anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Let us continue to do our very 
best starting tomorrow as well.
